content.text: The first one comes from the very first line. Mr. Campbell says hi ladies. Thanks for picking me up.
content.trans: 英语：第一条来自第一行。卡彭森女士，谢谢您接我上车。

content.text: That's right now this phrasal verb to pick someone up means to get them right to...
content.trans: 这个点和拍是傻瓜相机。

content.text: Yeah to gather them to collect them. You can do this with a car like I will pick you up at the airport
content.trans: 是的，我们可以一起收集他们。你可以这样和我一起开车去机场。

content.text: but you can also do it in person by just walking to a place and meeting somebody and then taking them somewhere else.
content.trans: 但是你也可以通过直接见面的方式，然后将他们带到另一个地方。

content.text: That's the important part. You take them somewhere else.
content.trans: 这个重要的部分是。你把它放在哪里？

content.text: So maybe if you go pick your kids up from school you just walk there you get them and you walk back home.
content.trans: 所以，如果你决定让你的孩子放学后直接回家，你只需要步行去接他们，然后步行回去。

content.text: That's right and so the key here is that you remember that the verb goes first I will pick and then you have the person.
content.trans: 这是正确的，那么接下来是这个关键点：记住动词先说，然后你有一个人。

content.text: I will pick you up. I will pick them up. He will pick us up.
content.trans: 我将接你上车。我会帮你接他们。他会接我们。

content.text: That's right so the subject goes between pick and up.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：“那对啊，这个话题要放在前面。”

content.text: That's right. Alright so we're going to pick someone up and then Mr. Campbell comments on the weather.
content.trans: 英语：那对，我们得先接上一个人，然后陈先生评论天气。

content.text: He says it's awful weather out there.
content.trans: 他说外面真糟糕。

content.text: It's awful. Alright so awful you listen to the tone you automatically think that this is probably a bad thing and you're right it is a bad thing.
content.trans: 太糟糕了。好吧，所以你听着，自动就知道这是个坏事情，你没错，这确实是件坏事。

content.text: But what's another way to say awful?
content.trans: 但是还有其他方式来表达糟糕的。

content.text: It's terrible it's bad it's horrible.
content.trans: 英语：它太糟糕了，简直无法忍受。

content.text: So awful is a way to say something's really bad and we use it very often with the weather. This weather is awful.
content.trans: 所以，说得很糟糕的方式是用这种方式来形容事情真的很糟糕，并且我们经常使用这种天气。

content.text: But we can also use it about other things like food for example.
content.trans: 但是我们也可以用它来制作食物，例如。

content.text: So if you have something to eat and it doesn't taste good you can say this is awful what is this?
content.trans: 所以如果你有东西要吃，而且它不怎么好吃，你可以这么说：“这是一只糟糕的家伙。”

content.text: Or what's that awful smell?
content.trans: 英语：或者那糟糕的气味。

content.text: Oh Marco took his shoes off.
content.trans: 英语：哦，马科。他脱下了鞋子。

content.text: Alright and well Mr. Campbell went on to tell them that he's taking another trip soon but a specific kind of trip.
content.trans: 好的，先生，卡彭特先生继续告诉他们他很快又要去旅行了，但是一次特定的旅行。

content.text: Alright so you know that there are many different kinds of trips but the one that he's taking is a business trip.
content.trans: 好的，你知道有很多不同的旅行方式，但这次他正在执行的是商务旅行。

content.text: So normally we could just say I'm going on a trip next year.
content.trans: 所以通常我们可以说我明年要出差。

content.text: But here we specify we say it's a business trip so what are we doing on this trip Marco?
content.trans: 但是，这里我们指定说这是出差，所以我们正在做什么Marco？

content.text: That's right so we're basically working.
content.trans: 是的，我们基本上都在工作。

content.text: We're going because our company needs us to go to a meeting or to do some work abroad.
content.trans: 我们去是因为我们的公司需要我们出差或者做一些国外的工作。

content.text: Alright so you know on a business trip that you'll be doing work things you'll be having meetings.
content.trans: 好的，您知道在出差期间，您将要处理的工作事项和需要召开的会议。

content.text: You will not be going to Disney World. You will not be meeting with friends and going to movies probably.
content.trans: 你不会去迪士尼世界。你可能要和朋友去看电影。

content.text: Right exactly so it's very different from a vacation.
content.trans: 正确翻译：非常准确地，它与度假完全不同。

content.text: Of a vacation you go with the objective of going to these fun places.
content.trans: 英语：你去度假的目的地是这些有趣的地点。

content.text: So can I say I'm going on a business vacation?
content.trans: 所以，我可以这么说，我正在度假。

content.text: No you either going on vacation or you're taking a business trip.

content.text: Alright business trip.

content.text: Melissa is talking to Mr. Campbell and he asks her how she is. Are you okay?
content.trans: 英语：梅丽莎正在和迈克尔交谈，她问她是否一切安好。

content.text: She says I'm great thanks.
content.trans: 她说我很棒，谢谢。

content.text: Now Marco why would we use this phrase instead of I'm fine thank you.
content.trans: 现在莫卡，我们为什么不使用这个短语而不是我没事了，请问呢？

content.text: Well it's basically the same thing. It's just another way of answering this common question. How are you?
content.trans: 英语：它基本上就是这个了。只是另一种回答这个问题的方式而已。你怎么样？

content.text: You can say I'm fine thank you. I'm well but this is just another way of saying I'm okay.
content.trans: 英语：你可以这么说，我很好，但这是另一种方式，表示我很好。

content.text: Alright but I think it's important to remember that this is also very casual like the rest of the conversation and pretty enthusiastic. She's great.
content.trans: 好的，但我认为这也很随意，和整个对话一样热情洋溢。她很好。

content.text: So it's important to remember that I'm fine thanks is standard. It's very normal but I'm great.
content.trans: 所以，我非常感谢标准。这是正常的，但我很好。

content.text: It's a nice way to change it and do something different.
content.trans: 英语：它是一种改变方式，做点不同。

content.text: That's right okay and now we wanted to ask if we have any plans but we wanted to know if we have any vacation plans.

content.text: So that's how he's that's the whole sentence.

content.text: Is something that we we'd want to hear right?

content.text: Because it's pretty clear who we're talking to. We're talking to Michelle right?

content.text: Right and we're talking about traveling and we're talking about plans.
content.trans: 英语：正确，但请纠正错误。正确的句子应该是：“Right and we're talking about traveling and we're talking about plans.”

content.text: So it's overstated that we don't really need to say do you have any vacation plans.

content.text: We're already talking about the subject.

content.text: Now this is a great way to transition.

content.text: One person is talking about himself or herself and then you want to talk about the other person.
content.trans: 英语：他/她正在谈论自己或自己，然后你想讨论另一个人。

content.text: So you say what about you?
content.trans: 英语：所以你说说你。

content.text: Mm hmm.
content.trans: 英语：mm hmm.

content.text: Any vacation plans or any dinner plans or any ideas?
content.trans: 任何度假计划或晚餐计划或想法？

content.text: Exactly. So it's a great way to say transition from one idea or from one person to another.
content.trans: 正确翻译：正好。所以这是一个很好的方式从一个想法或一个人过渡到另一个想法或人。

content.text: Now to the next phrase a very common one.
content.trans: 英语：现在到下一个话题一个常见的。

content.text: Specifically when you are not really sure about something but somebody told you specifically in this case,
content.trans: 英语：当你不确定某事，但有人告诉你这种情况时。

content.text: We've seen it that it's great.

content.text: I couldn't disagree more so you just changed that one word.

content.text: I couldn't disagree more.

content.trans: 英语：所以我们非常希望你的反馈，任何话题或你想要讨论的具体主题。

content.text: You can let us know at EnglishPod.com and also your questions and comments can be left there.
content.trans: 英语：你可以通过在这里的英文播客网站告诉我们，也可以在那儿留言和提出问题了。

content.text: That's right so please get in touch with us. EnglishPod.com. We'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 英语：那对了，让我们尽快联系你。请见谅，我们将在那里见到你们。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
